note: Claim: National Cat Day found blog posts repeating outdated shelter numbers that ASPCA's current statistics beat. Target says 'Some blog posts state 6.3 million animals surrendered annually with 920,000 euthanized; others ... cite 7.6 million' and 'The ASPCA's own current shelter statistics ... put the real numbers well below either of those recycled figures', reflecting 'a shelter system that has improved substantially'.
